scenarios.label: Concert ticketing
scenarios.description: Fans search events and attempt to reserve a limited seat during a short onsale window.
scenarios.invariant: A seat may be confirmed for at most one buyer.
missingQuestions: How long may a seat remain held before payment completes?
Must the seat map reflect a confirmed reservation immediately?
Can searches use a slightly stale availability count?

scenarios.label: Food delivery tracking
scenarios.description: Customers check order status while couriers publish location and delivery updates.
scenarios.invariant: A delivered order cannot transition back to preparing.
missingQuestions: How stale may courier location be before it becomes misleading?
Which status changes require proof of delivery?
Are courier updates accepted when the customer app is offline?

scenarios.label: Photo feed
scenarios.description: People upload photos and browse a personalized home feed.
scenarios.invariant: A private photo is visible only to authorized viewers.
missingQuestions: Does the payload include the original image or only feed metadata?
How quickly must a privacy change remove cached copies?
Is a newly uploaded photo required to appear in every follower feed immediately?
